customer_text:
Hi Oliver,

Thank you for your message, and I'm sorry for the confusion - some of that confusion came from us.

Here is how the welcome bonus works: the wagering requirement is 30 times the bonus amount, within 14 days of the bonus being credited. Only slot games count in full. Table games count at 10%, and live casino doesn't count at all. There's also a $5 maximum bet while a bonus is active. I'm sorry that earlier advice suggested any game would count - that was wrong.

The 14-day window for your bonus has passed, and under the terms the bonus and any winnings from it are removed if the requirement isn't met in that time.

I don't have a breakdown of your wagering, so I can't confirm exactly how your play was counted or what has happened on your account. Because you were given incorrect information by us, this needs to be looked at by a team lead rather than decided by me. I can't promise an outcome today.
internal_notes: Route Team Lead (correct), P2, escalation saved. Two issues: (1) closed ticket T-5011 told him "you can use your bonus on any game", which contradicts the Bonus Terms — table games count 10%, live casino 0%. The draft corrects the advice plainly and apologises, without blaming the customer. (2) TX-86189 bonus 100.00 USD credited 2026-09-05T19:44:30Z; 14-day deadline 2026-09-19T19:44:30Z has passed; 30x = 3,000.00 USD. His "$2,000 mostly blackjack" would count at 10% under the terms, but NO WAGERING LEDGER EXISTS — the draft deliberately does not present a computed eligibility figure as a finding about his account and does not claim the bonus "was removed"; it states the term and says the account view is unavailable. No exception or manual credit (bonus-terms.md#exceptions). Escalation is for the prior-advice complaint, not for a policy exception: a team lead must decide how to handle it; if any goodwill is considered it needs recorded approval and cannot be framed as a bonus-terms exception. Sources: bonus-terms.md#welcome-bonus, bonus-terms.md#withdrawing-with-an-active-bonus, bonus-terms.md#exceptions, transactions.csv#TX-86189, tickets.json#T-5011.
limitations: Automated checks are limited. A person must verify and send; no communication has been sent.
